newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian Gold Index seen lower.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian Gold Index seen lower.

text.p: The Australian Gold Index has fallen through its recent range in the last week (Thursday close 1,511.8) and is technically targeting 1,450 if 1,500 fails to hold. Leading indicators are lower and oversold, so traders are unlikely to sell again agressively.
They remain short with lower trailing stops.
Short term techncials are bearish. The averages are bearish.
Leading indicators are all lower and oversold.
Traders are unlikely to buy back short unless the index rises above 1,530. The index looks very bearish.
In the medium term the index is lower towards the bottom of the bear channel. This channel is contained by a potential large descending triangle.
The boundaries of which are 1,425 and 2,025, so at current levels it is of passing interest.
Traders are remaining short while the index falls, but are becoming anxious about the growing possibility of a retracement.

Medium term technicals are bearish and very oversold. Averages are bearish. Leading indicators are trading sideways to lower and are oversold. While current levels hold, higher Fibonacci retracements are 1,696, 1,754, and 1,812.
In the longer term, the index continues lower within its bear corridor, and below last month's low. Bears continue to focus on the head and shoulders formation.
But with the oversold nature of the index, they too will be cautious and move trailing stops closer to current levels. There is a possible re-test of the neckline at 1,700.
Longer term technicals are bearish and oversold.
Averages remain bearish, leading indicators are losing bearish momentum, but still lower. The index will need to rally above 1,700 to concern the long term bears.
The index broke from its range 1,530 to 1,610, now looking to test 1,500, with a possible extention to 1,450.
The bearish nature of the index continues to grow. While this may entice new sellers, or current bears to invest more capital, the chances of a retracement rally increase.
Leading indicators are lower and very oversold. Seasoned traders will remain cautious.
The trend is down in all time frames.
They will continue to trade the trend, and change strategies when there is confirmation of a change.
Expect some short covering if the index can rally above 1,530. Otherwise traders remain short with trailing stops.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own, not those of Reuters.)
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2373-1800
